'''Thunderpaw''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Voltazar]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "People have built shrines for Thunderpaw, where they present offerings of food and reverently await blessings. With a gentle lift of the paw, a flurry of lightning bolts can erupt from behind. But can Thunderpaw really bring good fortune? Certainly-if you believe in it!"

Thunderpaw is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Strategy==
You should use [[Flameow]]/evo alongside Thunderpaw because of the Paw Pals bond, giving Thunderpaw a 3% ATK speed increase. In stages with hordes of regular [[Zobos]], Thunderpaw could hold one lane.

When Thunderpaw's skill cooldown reaches minimum, its attack range increases by 1 tile.
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Thunderpaw was added to the game on 9/23/2026 alongside [[Dolphie]] and [[Cinderclaw]].
